method: Built-in image_gen edits. Original EV.io card as edit target; current Kryx model render as replacement reference. These composites retain source artwork backgrounds, and are not independently original artwork.

items.prompt: Edit Image 1, the square red lightning character card. Image 2 is the replacement in-game character model. Replace ONLY the armored character in Image 1 with the character design from Image 2. Faithfully use Image 2's pale gray and coral-red armor color blocks, faceted enclosed helmet with no glowing face slits, armor shapes, antenna, limbs and torso design. Repose that replacement character to match Image 1: upper body facing camera, both arms raised outward with open palms. Keep Image 1's exact composition, dark red smoky background, white glowing energy spheres in palms, red/white branching lightning, lighting direction, crop and dramatic mood. The replacement must visibly look like Image 2, not the original glossy character in Image 1. Match its faceted low-poly game-art finish while integrating red lighting from the scene. No text, no logo, no border. Square output.

Edit Image 1 (the teal character card) by replacing ONLY its character with the exact in-game character model design in Image 2. Preserve Image 1's teal circular energy vortex, tiny blue particles, black corners, original composition, crop and light direction. Pose Image 2's character in the same forward-leaning three-quarter upper-body pose as Image 1. Faithfully preserve Image 2's pale gray, muted teal and charcoal faceted armor, enclosed helmet silhouette, chest and shoulder geometry; keep its actual muted material colors with subtle teal light from the scene, do not replace it with the glossy bright-white emissive armor of Image 1. High fidelity to the replacement model. Crisp low-poly collectible card rendering. No text, no logos, no borders. Square.
